name: legitimate-verification-code
description: False-positive resistance for the most ordinary transactional mail there is: a one-time code being delivered. It contains the exact phrase an OTP phish contains, and the safety advice next to it names the code in the same words a request for one would ("never share your verification code"), which is what makes the negation load-bearing rather than incidental. From a domain no brand table contains and with no dampening available, so nothing but the rule's own precision keeps it low.
